(2) The scene cuts to a bathroom where the woman, now wearing a grey hoodie and a purple headband, is washing her face. She applies cleanser to her cheeks and forehead, rubbing in circular motions. The lighting is bright and typical of an indoor bathroom. (3) Next, she is shown applying various skincare products. First, she uses a cotton pad on her face in the studio setting. Then, she applies a clear liquid from a dropper onto her palms and pats it onto her cheeks. Later, she is seen in the bathroom again applying a white cream (sunscreen) to her forehead and face. (4) The scene shifts to a living room where she sits cross-legged on a sofa, meditating with her eyes closed in a calm, naturally lit environment. This is followed by a close-up of her drinking from a large glass mug. (5) She is then seen writing in a book with a fountain pen in a well-lit office. After this, she is back in the studio, wearing a blue patterned cardigan over her striped shirt, speaking directly to the camera with high energy. (6) The final sequence shows her in a clinical setting. She wears a white doctor's coat over her striped shirt, consulting with a patient and performing medical procedures using specialized equipment on a patient's face. She is also seen performing a minor surgical procedure under a bright surgical light. (7) The video concludes with her sitting at a red desk in an office, stretching her arms above her head as if exhausted, before transitioning to a white outro screen with contact information and logos.

Short 'pop' or 'bubble' sound effects punctuate the visual cuts of her applying products, synchronized with the rhythmic beat of the BGM. (4) The narrator's tone shifts slightly to a more professional, authoritative but still enthusiastic register during the filming and clinical segments. A cartoonish 'boing' or high-pitched slide sound effect is heard when she mentions treating acne. (5) In the final segment, a weary sigh or a cartoon 'tired' SFX coincides with the visual of her stretching. The music remains upbeat but begins a quick fade-out as the voiceover concludes with clinic information. The audio track ends cleanly with the final notes of the song.
